headline: Apartments in Baku districts near metro stations have risen in price - VIDEO
summary: Apartment prices in Baku districts near metro stations are rising in new buildings and on the secondary market. The housing price index rose 8.4% in Q3 2026 from a year earlier, per the Chamber of Appraisers.
why: Housing prices reflect credit conditions, incomes and construction activity, and are a key indicator for property investors and lenders.
